{{short description|Iranian-born American scientist (born 1945)}}

'''Sam Sofer''' (born 1945) is an Iranian-born American scientist who specializes in biological processes and bioreactor design, with applications in medicine, energy, and the environment. He is the creator of biological air and water cleaners that use [[Immobilized Cell Technology|immobilized cell technology]], and of various biomedical instruments and test protocols related to boosting the immune system to fight disease.

== Early life ==
Sofer was born Samir Salim Sofer, in [[Tehran]], [[Iran]]. He attended the [[Community School, Tehran|American Community School]] for his primary and secondary education.

== Education ==
Upon secondary school graduation Sofer attended the [[University of Utah]], where he earned an Honors [[Bachelor of Science]] in [[Chemical engineering|Chemical Engineering]]. Sofer went on to get a Masters of [[Engineering]] from [[Texas A&M University|Texas A & M University]], and a PhD in [[Chemical engineering|Chemical Engineering]] from the [[University of Texas at Austin]]. His PhD dissertation was titled 'Continuous production of drug metabolites by insolubilized hepatic microsomal oxidase'.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://catalog.lib.utexas.edu/search~S2?/XSofer&searchscope=2&SORT=D/XSofer&searchscope=2&SORT=D&SUBKEY=Sofer/1,3,3,B/frameset&FF=XSofer&searchscope=2&SORT=D&3,3,?save=b4940138|title=Continuous production of drug metabolites by insolubilizedhepatic microsomal oxidase|first=Samir Salim|last=Sofer|date=29 June 1974|accessdate=29 June 2018|website=Catalog.lib.utexas.edu}}</ref>

== Career ==
Sofer has been Professor and Director, Chemical Engineering and [[Materials science|Materials Science]] at the [[University of Oklahoma]]; and Research Chair Professor of Biotechnology at the [[New Jersey Institute of Technology]].

Sofer has industrial experience as a US chemical plant engineer, and has the following patents: Method and Spiral Bioreactor for Processing Feedstocks, U.S. Patent 6,916,630 B2, Jul. 12, 2005;<ref>{{cite web|url=https://patents.google.com/patent/US6916630B2/en|title=Method and spiral bioreactor for processing feedstocks|website=Patents.google.com|accessdate=29 June 2018}}</ref> Immune and Oxygen System Measuring and Drug Screening Method and Apparatus U.S. and International patents pending, 2012.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://patents.google.com/patent/JP2015028490A/en|title=Immune and oxygen system measuring and drug screening method and apparatus|website=Patents.google.com|accessdate=29 June 2018}}</ref>

Sofer is currently the President of Air & Water Solutions (NJ) and of ReGen Technology LLC (NM), all of which specialize in biological processes and bioreactor design.

==Technology applications ==
Sam Sofer's Spiral Bioreactor patent for air purification technology has been developed and industrialized and studied for the professional segment use by U-earth Biotech.
Sara Zanni Environmental Engineer, U-earth Chief Science Officer until 2019 in cooperation with UNIBO, the [[university of Bologna]], has published studies on the applications of AIRcel bioreactors derived by Sofer's patent, in the medical, industrial and commercial segment.

The system has been studied and research papers published in the industrial machining contest<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.researchgate.net/publication/294670080|title=Abatement and bio-digestion of airborne contamination in precision mechanics: the case study of Beretta firearms|first1=Sara|last1=Zanni|first2=Alessandra|last2=Bonoli|first3=Maurizio|last3=Mancini|date=21 May 2015|accessdate=29 June 2018|via=ResearchGate}}</ref> and in the waste treatment contest.<ref>{{cite journal|url=https://www.researchgate.net/publication/272504458|title=Indoor air quality in waste treatment: Environmental issue and biotechnology application for air pollution containment, a case study|first1=Sara|last1=Zanni|first2=Alessandra|last2=Bonoli|date=31 December 2014|journal=WSEAS Transactions on Environment and Development|volume=10|pages=529–541|accessdate=29 June 2018|via=ResearchGate}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.researchgate.net/publication/272504387|title=Air pollution treatment in modern segregated waste treatment facilities|first1=Sara|last1=Zanni|first2=Alessandra|last2=Bonoli|date=23 November 2014|accessdate=29 June 2018|via=ResearchGate}}</ref>
